in_marathi.name: Emanansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Emanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Emanansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'God of knowledge'. This name is associated with wisdom, intelligence, and enlightenment. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is often referred to as 'Emana', the god of knowledge, and 'Nansh', the god of wisdom and learning.
